fields.name: limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 20.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order by the `created_at` timestamp of the objects. `asc` for ascending order and `desc` for descending order.

fields.name: after
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the container was created.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status of the container (e.g., active, deleted).

fields.name: lastActiveAt
fields.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the container was last active.

fields.name: expiresAfter
fields.description:
The container will expire after this time period.
The anchor is the reference point for the expiration.
The minutes is the number of minutes after the anchor before the container expires.

fields.name: memoryLimit
fields.description: The memory limit configured for the container.

fields.name: networkPolicy
fields.description: Network access policy for the container.
